name: Noctyra Alpha
description: A ghostly commander leading their troops beyond death.

abilities.name: Silent Flight (2)
abilities.description: While flying, the Noctyra Alpha gains +2 Difficulty.

abilities.name: Command the Hunt
abilities.description: When the Alpha is spotlighted, mark a Stress to also spotlight up to two Noctyra within Close range, one at a time. Each can move and take an action.

abilities.name: Blackbriar Snare
abilities.description: Choose a point within Close range. Targets within Very Close range make an Agility Reaction Roll (15). Failure: 2d8+3 magic damage and Restrained. Success: Half damage. Restrained targets escape with a Strength or Agility Roll (15).

abilities.name: Flyby Assault
abilities.description: Choose a target within Far range and make an attack. Success: Deal 2d10+8 physical damage. The target makes an Agility Reaction Roll (15). Success: Alpha ends anywhere within Far range. Failure: Target becomes Restrained and is carried with the Alpha to anywhere within Far range. A carried target escapes with a Strength or Agility Roll (15). If released while airborne, they take 1d12+5 physical damage from the fall unless they prevent it.
